definitions.explanation: A piece of lumber sawn into a square or rectangular cross-section, used as a structural member in carpentry and DIY work. The opposite of round timber ({丸太|まるた}).

examples.japanese: {角材|かくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二本|にほん}⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought two pieces of square lumber.

examples.japanese: {角材|かくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I cut some square lumber and built a shelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧{角材|かくざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The square timbers supporting the floor had deteriorated, so I replaced them.

notes:
Sold by cross-section size (e.g., {2|に}×{4|よん}⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ for two-by-four). Standard stock at hardware stores and lumber yards.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {角材|かくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut square lumber
- ⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{角材|かくざい}: wooden square timber
- ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧{角材|かくざい}: thick square timber

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{丸太|まるた}→丸太：15347_maruta⟧: round timber; log — uncut, round cross-section
- {板材|いたざい}: plank lumber — flat boards
- ⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧: lumber; timber — general term covering all forms
